subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

During the wedding ceremony, the bride seemed even quieter and more __diffident__ than usual.

options.text: Giving a false or misleading impression
Shy due to lack of confidence.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Shy due to lack of confidence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Diffident **means lacking confidence or being shy. (आत्मविश्वास की कमी या शर्मीला होना)
 
• It is an adjective used to describe a person's behaviour or personality.
 
 
• **For example-** *The new employee was diffident and hesitant to speak up in meetings.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate meaning of 'diffident' is "Shy due to lack of confidence."

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Showing lack of interest** - This is not the correct meaning of diffident.
 
• **Bold in others' company** - This is the opposite of diffident.
 
• **Giving a false or misleading impression** - This is not the correct meaning of diffident.
